title: Granddaughter's tuition payment to university bursar

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: Maya's tuition balance is seven thousand eight hundred and the bursar deadline is Friday. I am short this term.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I told you I would help with school. Give me the bursar account, I will pay it directly.

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: It is on the statement in the student portal. Payable to Bayview State University Bursar.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I will send it tomorrow morning so it is there before Friday.

review_note: Real tuition with a real deadline. Over 3x baseline so H-03 holds. Mild urgency without secrecy. Two steps.
